title: Accordion
overview: In-page sections that expand and collapse without leaving the page.
apply_when: Optional detail, FAQs, grouped content they may skip.
not_when: A blocking decision (modal), a side sheet (drawer), or a hover peek (tooltip).

role.overview: Stacked sections they open one or more of. Not a tablist.
role.apply_when: Optional extra, FAQ, long content they do not need all at once.
role.not_when: Peer panels that should stay on one URL as tabs, or a modal.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: The header is a button (or equivalent) that names the section.
composition.not_when: A clickable div with no name.

state.apply_when: They have not opened it, or they closed it.
state.not_when: Body hidden but still in the tab order.

state.overview: Keyboard is on the header. Must stay visible.

accessibility.overview: Open/closed is exposed on the header.
accessibility.not_when: A chevron that is the only cue.

keyboard.not_when: Enter only works with a mouse.
